svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Agentic RAG on IBM watsonx subtitle: An Orchestrate agent searches OpenRAG, queries Iceberg tables with Presto and answers with Granite direction: down layout: { spacing: compact } # IBM's technical diagram guide asks for a legend in every diagram, so solid lines get one too. legend: solid: Question and answer path dashed: Document ingestion dotted: Agent monitoring groups: # orrery has no IBM group styles; IBM's guide draws groups as plain outlined boxes, so these use # the neutral types with Carbon icons in the headers, as in ibm-cloud-openshift. ibmcloud: { type: box, label: IBM Cloud, icon: ibm:ibm-cloud } wxd: { type: box, label: watsonx.data, icon: ibm:watsonx-data, in: ibmcloud } # OpenRAG is IBM's open RAG package (Langflow, Docling and OpenSearch), offered as OpenRAG on # watsonx.data. It ships an MCP server, so the agent calls search as a tool. openrag: { type: dashed, label: OpenRAG, in: wxd } nodes: staff: { icon: ibm:user-multiple, label: Employees, note: Chat } docs: { icon: ibm:object-storage, label: Cloud Object Storage, note: Policy and product documents, in: ibmcloud } # align puts governance and the model in the agent's row, on either side of it, so the agent's # monitoring and prompt lines stay short. gov: { icon: ibm:watsonx-governance, label: watsonx.governance, note: Evaluations and guardrail metrics, align: agent, in: ibmcloud } agent: { icon: ibm:ibm-watsonx-orchestrate, label: watsonx Orchestrate, note: Support agent, in: ibmcloud } langflow: { icon: si:langflow, label: Langflow, note: Ingest and retrieval flows, in: openrag } search: { icon: logos:opensearch-icon, label: OpenSearch, note: Vector and keyword index, in: openrag } docling: { icon: ibm:document-processor, label: Docling, note: Parse and chunk, in: openrag } presto: { icon: logos:presto-icon, label: Presto, note: SQL engine, in: wxd } llm: { icon: ibm:watsonx-ai, label: watsonx.ai, note: Granite chat model, align: agent, in: ibmcloud } # The Iceberg bucket is the storage registered with watsonx.data, so it sits in that box, beside # the Presto engine that reads it. lake: { icon: ibm:object-storage, label: Cloud Object Storage, note: Iceberg tables, align: presto, in: wxd } edges: - staff -> agent: ask - agent -> langflow: MCP search - langflow -> search: hybrid search - agent -> presto: SQL tool - presto -> lake: read tables - agent -> llm: prompt with context # Ingestion runs when documents land in the bucket, apart from the question path. - docs --> langflow: new documents - langflow --> search: index chunks - langflow --> docling: parse - agent ..> gov: traces

svg.title: Agentic RAG on IBM watsonx
svg.desc: Agentic RAG on IBM watsonx. 10 components in 3 groups. Connections: Employees to watsonx Orchestrate (ask); watsonx Orchestrate to Langflow (MCP search); Langflow to OpenSearch (hybrid search); watsonx Orchestrate to Presto (SQL tool); Presto to Cloud Object Storage (read tables); watsonx Orchestrate to watsonx.ai (prompt with context); Cloud Object Storage to Langflow (new documents); Langflow to OpenSearch (index chunks); Langflow to Docling (parse); watsonx Orchestrate to watsonx.governance (traces).

text.tspan: An Orchestrate agent searches OpenRAG, queries Iceberg tables with Presto and answers with Granite
